body:
SUPERSEDED by the existing memory central-restart-cargo-run-rebuilds-exe (rev 4), which I should have read before the install. Greg starts every host with git pull plus cargo run --release, so an installed copy is always rebuilt or relinked. Same commit, different sha is EXPECTED; do not re-install to match. After a restart, verify from files only:
- the checkout HEAD and that it is clean;
- the sha256 and mtime of target/release/termal.exe;
- that the host answers.
Name the build "Greg's git pull + cargo run --release at HEAD X, sha Y". No process checks (Greg, 2026-11-16).
2026-11-18 instance: HEAD bf9bd691; the installed copy a05fc94f was rebuilt at 16:38:04Z to cae306ca.
Still useful: the mailbox scripts use TERMAL_CLI = target/release/termal.exe. While that file is renamed aside during an install, point TERMAL_CLI at the backup exe.
